purpose: Freeze the future comparison method before observing enough fresh outcomes. This file does not authorize running M10V now and does not modify M10P or M10P2.

execution_gate.reason: 20 resolved is the predeclared first formal fresh review point for both independent families.

windows.standalone_view: Retain each family's full own fresh window for standalone metrics.
windows.common_window_rule: For direct family comparison and portfolio interaction, use only decisions at or after the later immutable start so both families were prospectively observable.

required_views: standalone full-fresh metrics for each family
common-window standalone metrics for each family
signal count and accepted trade count
simultaneous candidate and simultaneous accepted-trade counts
daily entry-date PnL correlation on the common window

single_capital_policy.active_position_rule: While an accepted 240-minute position is active, later candidate entries from either family are skipped for the single-capital view.
single_capital_policy.same_timestamp_same_direction_rule: If both families qualify at the exact same decision timestamp, materialize one SHORT position only and attribute the event to both families for overlap accounting; do not double size or double PnL.
single_capital_policy.risk_sizing: one normalized unit; no post-outcome sizing optimization
